## What

Run CCSDS 123 inline on the carrier, with a CRC per segment.

**Stretch:** fall back to raw output on a fault, and reset the predictor every
60 frames so one corrupted segment cannot poison the rest of the pass.

## Done when

- [ ] Compressed passes on the carrier are **bit-exact** with the software
      reference.
